notes.title: We're Leaving Steam
notes.notes: [p]Hello,[/p][p][/p][p]We have decided to unpublish the game from Steam, due to players inactivity and missing any new players. That being said, the game will keep working for existing players.[/p][p][/p][p]We're planning to distribute the game on some other platforms sometime later, but first we'll have to make it not relying on certain services.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p]

notes.title: New Game Modes Added
notes.notes:
[h2]Drawing Mode[/h2]
[h3]Available in Singleplayer and Online Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*]Create art directly on your desktop.
[*]Non-blocking interaction with your operating system.
[i](This feature may be adjusted in future updates.)[/i]
[/list]
[h2]Party Mode[/h2]
[h3]Available in Online Multiplayer[/h3]
[list]
[*] No rules, infinite pixels, socialize and fool around.
[/list]
Stay tuned for more new features soon.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update
notes.notes: The drawing game mode is now available for online multiplayer.

notes.title: Beta Branch Update
notes.notes:
The new drawing singleplayer game mode has been enhanced with the following improvements:
[list]
[*] An eraser tool has been added for better editing capabilities.
[*] Drawn pixels are now bolder for improved visibility and clarity.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Branch Now Available
notes.notes:
The beta branch of the game is now available.
You can switch to the beta branch to test new features and provide feedback.

[h2]What's New[/h2]
[h3]Singleplayer Drawing Mode[/h3]
A new game mode where you can draw directly on the screen.

[h2]To switch to the beta branch on Steam[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Open your Steam Library.
[*] Right-click on the game title and select "Properties".
[*] Go to the "Betas" tab.
[*] In the drop-down menu, select "beta".
[*] Wait for the update to download.
[/olist]
